A [[Charr Salvage Kit]] is a type of [[kit]] that provides the only method for pre-Searing characters to obtain [[upgrade component]]s. They look and work the same as [[Expert Salvage Kit]]s; however, they have only five uses and they can only be obtained as [[drop]]s from one of the [[Charr]] [[boss]]es or [[Maz's Chest]].

== Notes ==
* This kit used to be the only means of salvaging equipment modifiers while in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]], including weapon upgrades, [[Runes]], or [[Insignias]]. With the introduction of [[The Purveyor]] players are able to obtain the [[Infinite Superior Salvage Kit]] in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* As with any kit, its value will decrease proportionally as it is used.
* Although it is gold, identifying it will not contribute to the [[Wisdom]] title track (however it will increase the value of the kit if sold to a [[merchant]]).
* These kits can be used to salvage [[rare crafting material]]s, but there is no point in doing so: rare materials cannot be used in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* The base chance, before the [[Wisdom]] and [[Treasure Hunter]] bonuses, of breaking an item upon salvaging an upgrade is 50%.

== Trivia ==
* Charr Salvage Kits were introduced in the [[Game updates/20070622|June 22, 2007 game update]].
